I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That feeling of being "put-together" is real armor. You're not hiding; you're *assembling*—taking raw materials and intentionally shaping how you present yourself to the day. It's a form of self-respect that says: "I deserve this care, this attention, this pause before the chaos."

Keep taking your time. The day can wait.
